title: 7 Things a Godly Man's Closest Friends Know About Him
caption:
7 things a godly man's closest friends know about him.

His fears, his fights, how he loses, what he's ashamed of. Real brotherhood isn't a group chat. It's two or three men who have his number and know the truth.

Proverbs 27:17: iron sharpens iron. You can't be sharpened by a man who has never seen the edge.

Who knows number two about you?
